EnterValidHex.message: Enter a valid hex code, e.g. 0x1A

EnterValidTextLength.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000

allowSiteAccess.message: Allow access to websites in the Chrome window that has opened.

autoReloadHint.message: Reloads the page in the current tab at the chosen interval. Stops when you reload the page yourself, open another page in this tab or close it. Works in several tabs at once, also with the panel closed.

autoReloadInvalidSeconds.message: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 86400.

autoReloadPresetHint.message: Reload the current page at this interval

autoReloadSecondsHint.message: Your interval in seconds (Enter to start)

autoReloadStop.message: Stop auto-reload in the current tab

captureAreaHint.message: Drag to select a part of the page

captureFullPageHint.message: Scrolls and captures the whole page

captureTabChanged.message: Capture stopped: the active tab changed.

captureTruncated.message: The page is too long: the screenshot was cut off at the bottom.

captureVisibleHint.message: Capture what you see on the screen

clearSiteDataHint.message: Deletes cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cache and service workers of the current site and reloads the page

createGifTip.message: Save the selected part as an animated GIF (15 frames per second)

cropFrameHint.message: Keep only a part of the picture: drag on the video to draw a rectangle, drag it to move, drag the squares to resize

downloadVideoTip.message: Save the selected part as a WebM video

extensionDescription.description: Chrome Web Store summary and chrome://extensions description (max 132 characters).
extensionDescription.message: Side panel for manual QA: test data typed into fields, special characters, notes, screenshots with editor, screen recording to GIF.

insertBusy.message: Still typing the previous value: press "Stop" or Esc

insertModeBypassHint.message: Click on a value writes it into the field with the cursor on the page at once, ignoring maxlength and key filters, then sends "input". To check the validation on the server.

insertModeCopyHint.message: Click on a value copies it to the clipboard

insertModeTypeHint.message: Click on a value types it character by character into the field with the cursor on the page (keydown → character → keyup). For input masks, autocomplete, search with a delay. The old text of the field is replaced.

insertNoField.message: Click into a text field on the page first, then on the value

insertRejected.message: The browser did not accept this value for this type of field (for example letters in a number field)

insertStopHint.message: Stop typing (or press Esc on the page). What is already typed stays.

insertTypedLimited.message: Typed $1 of $2 characters: the field did not accept the rest

insertTyping.message: Typing… Esc on the page or "Stop" to stop

noSiteAccess.message: No access to websites. Click a capture button again and choose "Allow", or set Site access → "On all sites" in chrome://extensions.

pageRestricted.message: This does not work on this page (browser pages, Chrome Web Store, extension pages).

recordStartHint.message: Record a tab, a window or the screen: Chrome will ask what to record. The recording goes on with the panel closed.

recordingNotFound.message: Recording not found. Only the last 3 recordings are kept.

savedValuesPageHint.message: The values of the Notes tab. Empty values and repeats are not saved. Drag ⠿ to reorder.

screenshotNotFound.message: Screenshot not found. Only the last 10 screenshots are kept.

selectAreaOnPage.message: Select an area on the page (Esc or right click — cancel)

testDataDeleteGroupConfirm.message: Delete the group "$1" with all its values?

testDataDeleteSectionConfirm.message: Delete the subgroup "$1" with all its values?

testDataExportHint.message: Save all groups and saved values to a JSON file (backup, another computer)

testDataImportConfirm.message: Replace all groups with $1 groups from the file?

testDataImportConfirmBoth.message: Replace the groups ($1) and the saved values ($2) with the ones from the file?

testDataImportConfirmSaved.message: Replace the saved values with $1 values from the file?

testDataImportFailed.message: The file has no test data groups

testDataImportHint.message: Load groups and saved values from a JSON file (replaces the current ones)

testDataNoGroupSelected.message: Choose a group on the left or add a new one

testDataNoGroups.message: No groups: add them in the settings

testDataPageHint.message: Groups, subgroups and values for the Utilities tab. Changes are saved at once. Drag ⠿ to reorder; drop a value or a subgroup on another group to move it there.

testDataResetConfirm.message: Replace all groups with the default set? Your changes will be lost.

testDataResetHint.message: Replace all groups with the default set (saved values stay)

toolSelect.message: Pointer: select, move and resize drawings (double click — edit text, Delete — remove)

trimEnd.message: End of the part to save

trimEndHere.message: End here (at the current moment of the video)

trimStart.message: Start of the part to save

trimStartHere.message: Start here (at the current moment of the video)
